Prose Reader Check

The three dev prose papers read by the prose reader (v4, 2026-11-04: captions skipped, lists read item by item, passages with unused numbers re-read, lead-word context; species tracking at headings and bold names; body-part labels in front of part names, whole-field rows, method split off), no scorer involved. Each species appears once: the GT's rows on the left, ours on the right. Rows with the same trait and the same value share a line first, then rows with the same value under another name, then the same trait with another value; a trait's rows stay together. Species are grouped by genus initial and epithet, so "A. sroczki" and "Alucita sroczki Ustjuzhanin & Kovtunovich" land together. Click a value to read all of it.
